The '''Zygerrian blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by the [[Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was one of the two favored weapons of the Zygerrians, the other being the [[shock whip]]. On one setting, the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] was capable of generating a large explosion on contact with solid objects. The [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] also made use of these weapons.
